content: 1. Administer 11 mg of pyrantel base per kilogram of body weight orally once daily for three consecutive days. Do not exceed a maximum dose of 1 gram per administration. 2. For patients over 2 years of age, administer 11 mg of pyrantel base per kilogram of body weight orally as a single dose. This dose may be repeated after 14 days if necessary. The medication can be taken with food. 3. For children under 2 years of age, the safety and efficacy of pyrantel have not been established. 4. For patients over 2 years of age, administer 11 mg of pyrantel base per kilogram of body weight orally every two weeks for a total of two doses. Do not exceed 1 gram per dose. 5. Pyrantel pamoate and piperazine may antagonize each other’s effects through pharmacodynamic interactions, potentially reducing their efficacy. The clinical significance of this interaction is unknown. 6. Pyrantel pamoate may increase the levels of theophylline in the body through an unspecified interaction mechanism. The clinical significance of this interaction is also unknown. 7. Common side effects of pyrantel include dizziness, drowsiness, insomnia, headache, rash, anorexia, nausea, vomiting, abdominal cramps, diarrhea, tenesmus, elevated liver function tests (LFTs), weakness, hypersensitivity reactions, and, in rare cases, intestinal obstruction or hepatic disease. 8. Use caution when prescribing pyrantel to patients with anemia, hepatic impairment, or malnutrition. Some formulations may contain sodium benzoate, which requires additional consideration. 9. Treat all family members or close contacts of the patient, as intestinal worm infections are highly contagious and can spread easily within households. 10. Pyrantel is classified as Pregnancy Category C. Use during pregnancy only if clearly needed, as there is insufficient evidence regarding its safety in pregnant women. It is unknown whether pyrantel passes into breast milk. 11. Pyrantel acts as a depolarizing neuromuscular blocker, inhibiting cholinesterase activity and causing spastic paralysis of helminths. 12. Pyrantel has poor systemic absorption, is partially metabolized in the liver, and reaches peak plasma concentrations within 1 to 3 hours. Approximately 50% of the drug is excreted in feces, and 7% is excreted in urine. 13. Pyrantel is used to treat intestinal worm infections, including pinworm, roundworm, and hookworm. It belongs to the anthelmintic class of drugs. 14. For self-treatment of pinworm infections, take pyrantel as a single dose. For other worm infections, follow your doctor’s instructions, which may involve a single dose or multiple doses over several days. 15. If using the chewable tablet form, chew thoroughly before swallowing. If using the liquid form, shake the bottle well before each dose and measure the dose carefully with a proper measuring device. 16. Do not exceed a total dose of 1 gram in a single administration. 17. If self-treating for pinworms, take the medication only once and do not repeat the dose without consulting your doctor. 18. Side effects such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal cramps, headache, drowsiness, dizziness, insomnia, or loss of appetite may occur. Serious allergic reactions are rare. 19. Before taking pyrantel, inform your doctor if you have any allergies or medical conditions. Avoid alcohol or marijuana while taking this medication, as they may exacerbate dizziness or drowsiness. 20. Store pyrantel at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Dispose of expired or unused medication properly. 21. In case of overdose, seek immediate medical attention. In the U.S., call 911 or the Poison Control Center at 1-800-222-1222. In Canada, call 1-844-764-7669. 22. To prevent reinfection, ensure all household members are treated, clean the home thoroughly, wash clothing and bedding, and maintain good personal hygiene, including frequent handwashing and trimming fingernails. 23. This medication should only be used for the condition prescribed by your doctor. 24. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about pyrantel and its use in your specific health condition.
